meta.emission_policy: an entry emits tool/reasoning parser flags iff its confidence is one of [recipe-proven, template-identical-to-recipe-proven] unless the entry carries an explicit 'emit' bool
meta.architecture_fallback: An architecture counts as a match key only where every row carrying that architecture agrees on the emitted parser values (Qwen3_5MoeForConditionalGeneration: qwen3_xml/qwen3 everywhere; Qwen3ForCausalLM: single hermes row, emit=false). Ambiguous families — Qwen2ForCausalLM, Qwen3NextForCausalLM, NemotronHForCausalLM — are NOT architecture keys: a model unknown to the map but of such an architecture gets no tool flags rather than a first-row guess.
